enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Stunning +6: +6 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.

Animal Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Animals, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +2 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against the foe.
Unbalancing: Anything that melee attacks a character with an Unbalancing item has a chance to be pulled off balance giving them a -2 penalty to their AC.

children.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.+4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Staggering Blow: This item is enchanted to make your attacks send enemies reeling. When you roll a 20 on an attack with a melee weapon you will knock the target down unless it makes a DC 17 Balance check.
